text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! I finally got it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Haru Urara handing a 
plushie to a student who looked downcast.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Here, this is for you! When you hug it, 
it's super fluffy and feels so nice~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And if you sleep with it, you'll feel 
totally relieved~! That way, I'm sure all 
your worries about messing up on stage 
will disappear!

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Junior
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... I suppose... that might make 
things a little easier...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then let's dance together next! Moving 
your body is sure to fill you with energy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa... Waaah, aaaaah~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I messed up~! Let's try it on an 
easier mode next time!

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
...Urara-senpai is... so strong, huh. Even 
if you fail, you just laugh it off and 
bounce right back... U-Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ehh?! Why are you crying?! ...Wh-What 
do I do~~?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, if it isn't Urara! And... huh? Is 
that girl crying?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Did something happen...?! If you don't 
mind, tell us what's wrong, Urara-chan.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Teio-chan, Tsuro-chan! Umm, well, errr...!

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I'm supposed to perform on stage at 
the shopping district soon. But... when I 
think about everyone watching me, I get so 
nervous thinking 'what if I mess up?'...

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
I froze up again today and couldn't move! 
Tamamo-senpai, who's performing with me, 
covered for me, but... at this rate, I'm 
just going to cause trouble for 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
And then, when I was feeling down... 
Urara-senpai came and called out to me. 
She was trying so hard to cheer me up...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But... did I say something wrong? I'm 
sorry. I wasn't very good at it.

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
N-No! That's not it at all! You did so 
much for my sake... I'm just the hopeless 
one here...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In other words, your trouble is getting 
nervous in front of people, right? Then 
why don't we start by gradually getting 
you used to having eyes on you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's play a dance game 
together! If you dance with me, the whole 
gallery will be watching! I'm sure it'll 
make great practice for getting used to 
being seen!

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
B-But... if we stand out that much, I 
definitely won't be able to move...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's what the practice is for! I'll 
stick with you until you get used to it!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Teio is here today?! Man, those 
steps of hers are seriously amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Underclassman
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You'll be fine! Do your beeeessst~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about your surroundings! Just 
focus entirely on clearing the game!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! This dance is just for you 
and me! Let's have fun and dance together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay, stage cleared! How was that? How does 
it feel to finish dancing without getting 
nervous?

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Ah?! Y-You're right, the song ended before 
I even realized...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If you keep getting used to it at 
this rate, you won't feel nervous on stage 
either, right?

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! I feel like... I might actually 
be able to do the stage now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Very good, very good! Keep up that 
momentum with your practice~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~... You two are so cool! That felt 
just like real senpais!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm so jealous! I wanna become a 
dependable senpai just like both of you~!
